data.cultural_impact: The name Sujoy holds a significant cultural impact in the Indian society as it is associated with happiness, prosperity, and success. The name also has connections to the Hindu deities Ganesha and Lakshmi, who symbolize success and happiness, respectively.

The name serves as a constant reminder of the power of positivity and the potential within each person to make a difference in the lives of those around them.
